items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: I knew Frank Passley, and he talked me into it -- him and Happy Prince. ... Good old Frank Passley played with them, too? Yes, Frank Passley.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, Frank Passley(?). Because we got some of them on yesterday's tape, but I wasn't sure.
Yeah, Frank Passley(?) was from New Orleans. Alex Hill, incidentally, wasn't from New Orleans. He was from a town called North Little Rock, Arkansas -- Argenna(?). Argenna, Arkansas.
